name: securacv_audio
description: SecuraCV Audio — privacy-safe acoustic event detection. Brings up the on-board PDM microphone, computes a 50 Hz RMS envelope, and matches NFPA 72 / UL 2034 alarm cadences (T3 smoke, T4 CO). No audio frames ever leave the device — the only output that crosses the privacy barrier is {event_type, time_bucket, confidence}.
